mufradat.gloss: النَّبْزُ: التَّلْقِيب. قال الله تعالى: ﴿وَلا تَنابَزُوا بِالْأَلْقابِ﴾ [الحجرات : 11] .

lane.gloss: نبز نَبَزَهُ 1 , aor. ﹻ, inf. n. نَبْزٌ, He called him, or named him, by a by-name, surname, or nickname; he by-named him, surnamed him, or nicknamed him; syn. لَقَّبَهُ; (S, Msb, K;) mostly signifying he called him, or named him, by a nickname, a name of reproa
